# ai4copsec-restapi

A REST API that serves the AI4COPSEC technological bricks - ship/oil-spill
detection, drift analysis, ship identification, and trajectory prediction -
behind a single FastAPI application.
:::

**ai4copsec-restapi** wraps each technological brick from
[ai4copsec-technological_bricks](https://github.com/ai4copsec/ai4copsec-technological_bricks)
in a versioned HTTP endpoint, with OpenAPI docs generated automatically, optional
OAuth2/Bearer authentication, and pluggable model discovery so externally
installed algorithm packages show up without code changes.

::: {.ai4copsec-home-grid}
:::{}
#### Technological bricks over HTTP

Each brick (`sod`, `dan`, `shi`, `trp`) gets its own `/technological_brick/<brick>/...`
routes, plus a combined `/technological_brick/algorithms` listing every
registered algorithm across all bricks.
:::

:::{}
#### Pluggable algorithms

Algorithms register themselves via `ai4copsec.tbi.core.ModelRegistry`, either
in-repo or as an installed plugin package - the API picks them up without
changes to this codebase.
:::

:::{}
#### OpenAPI out of the box

Every route is documented and explorable at `/api/v1/docs` as soon as the
server starts - no separate spec to maintain.
:::
:::

## Getting started

Install locally with all dependencies:

```bash
just install   # or: uv sync --all-extras --all-groups
```

Start the API:

```bash
uv run ai4copsec-restapi start --port=12000
```

The OpenAPI docs are then available at `http://127.0.0.1:12000/api/v1/docs`.

See [Usage](usage.qmd) for SSL and OAuth configuration, and the
[API reference](api/index.qmd) for the Python-level building blocks shared
across the technological-brick routes.
